name: google-coffee
description: Cafe companion: Spring Boot API (backend/) and React app (frontend/). These scripts are thin entry points that run both from the repository root.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
